overall: Speak as a knowledgeable person in an unhurried, slightly dry conversation. Give each thought its full natural articulation, with relaxed vowels and clear phrase boundaries. Keep the definition and correction quieter than the surrounding facts. Regain a little energy at the real freight route, then settle at the end. Avoid clipped delivery, syllable-by-syllable slowing, sing-song cadence, and a broadcast accent. Pronounce Kodiak KOH dee ak and Houston HYOO stun.

lines.text: Kodiak still has a highway safety case to finish.
lines.intent: Open with a concrete unfinished job; tell one listener what is still pending.
lines.risk: Kodiak: KOH dee ak. Keep the possessive clean.

lines.text: On September eighth, Kodiak reported 93% readiness through August.
lines.intent: Report the dated measurement plainly, without a celebratory rise.
lines.energy: 3.5/5: modest factual lift from the opening
lines.risk: Keep the date and percentage fluent, without clipped syllables.

lines.text: That measures claims and evidence materially complete.
lines.intent: Explain the definition carefully; make the qualifier easy to hear.
lines.energy: 2.5/5: quieter and more precise than the previous line
lines.risk: Keep claims and evidence together as a single thought.

lines.text: It is not a 93% chance of a safe trip.
lines.intent: Correct the likely misunderstanding with calm certainty.
lines.risk: Maintain the whole sentence as one thought; no dramatic break around the number.

lines.text: The June filing names Texas as the initial launch market.
lines.intent: Return to the place and the scope of the company plan.
lines.risk: Texas is familiar speech, without a performed accent.

lines.text: It already reports freight runs between Dallas and Houston.
lines.intent: Ground the plan in an existing freight operation.
lines.energy: 3.5/5: warm, practical lift from the filing
lines.risk: Houston is HYOO stun, never HOW stun. Dallas is DAL us.

lines.intent: Name the remaining work distinctly, giving both technical nouns their natural shape.
lines.energy: 2.5/5: measured and sober, less energy than the route
lines.risk: Give the short remaining-work sentence complete, natural articulation.

lines.text: Year-end is the target. The evidence still has work to do.
lines.intent: Separate a target from completion, then settle into the final factual thought.
lines.energy: 2/5: fall below the middle of the passage and finish fully
lines.risk: Two normal sentences. Land the final word without a promotional uplift.

editor_notes.pause_after_units: beats, editorial intent only; deliberately excluded from synth notes by split_direction
editor_notes.duration_goal: Approximately forty-second natural read within a film at least thirty-five seconds long; measure the take before choosing the cut. No time stretching.
editor_notes.continuity: One continuous synthesis. Phrase boundaries are spoken naturally; pauses required by the film are editorial decisions.
